label: End-of-episode GO choosing a2 (low value)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (94% of mass), only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (ep_trial 90-99 hold 99.6% of mass; never before trial 80), and almost only when the agent picks a2 (94% of mass; strongly negative choice logit). Equivalently it tracks the low value-head output that marks the episode ending: everything active has value < 5.22. Recorded predicate: GO & value < 4 & upcoming action a2 (dev P 0.74, R 0.75, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.88). The ep_trial >= 93 version scores similarly (F1 0.68). action is the agent's own upcoming choice, which it computes, so no unobservable future variable is used. Magnitude grows toward the end of the episode, and in the top examples it is larger after an unrewarded previous trial (r0: about 0.9-1.0 of max) than after a rewarded one (r1: about 0.55-0.7). Weak activity spills onto D2 after an a2 choice that reached S1 (rare). It never fires at D1, on a1 GO steps outside the last trials, or earlier in the episode. The misses are mostly weak D2 or a1 activations late in the episode.
